requirements.title: Emotional and Cultural Intelligence
requirements.transferRequirements: One course,  equivalent to 3 units,  in emotional and cultural intelligence in organizations. This course can be met with organizational behavior, psychology of work, management principles, applications of management or management skills. Cannot be satisfied by an associate or bachelor’s degree.

requirements.title: Business Communication
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in business communication, with an emphasis in business writing. Can be satisfied by an associate or bachelor’s degree in business excluding AAS degree.

requirements.title: Principles of Management
requirements.transferRequirements: ​​One course, equivalent to 4 units, in management or leadership principles.

requirements.title: Functions of Human Resource Management
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in human resource management. May also be transferred if a student holds a valid HRCI: aPHR, PHR, SPHR, or GPHR certification. or the SHRM: CP or SCP. All certifications must have been completed or renewed within the last 5 years.

requirements.title: Health, Fitness, and Wellness
requirements.transferRequirements: ​One course, equivalent to 3-4 units, in health, wellness, or nutrition, excluding physical activity or EMT courses.

requirements.title: Innovative and Strategic Thinking
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, on strategy to drive business growth and achieve competitive advantage. May also be transferred if a student holds a valid HRCI: PHR or SPHR, or SHRM: CP or SCP. All certifications must have been completed or renewed within the last 5 years. Cannot be satisfied by an associate or bachelor’s degree.

requirements.title: Business Environment Applications I: Business Structures and Legal Environment
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 2 units, in business law as it applies to different business structures.

requirements.title: Introduction to Communication: Connecting with Others
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in communications.

requirements.title: Concepts in Marketing, Sales, and Customer Contact
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in marketing fundamentals that include brand management,  digital management and customer relationship management.

requirements.title: Introduction to Business Accounting
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in business accounting or managerial accounting. Cannot be satisfied by an associate or bachelor’s degree.

requirements.title: Critical Thinking: Reason and Evidence
requirements.transferRequirements: ​One course, equivalent to 3 units, in critical thinking, reasoning, argument or logic.

requirements.title: Composition: Successful Self-Expression
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in english composition. Excluding business writing and technical writing.

requirements.title: Introduction to Business Finance
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in business finance. Cannot be satisfied by personal finance, general finance, or an associate or bachelor’s degree.

requirements.title: Introduction to Sociology
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in sociology or anthropology.

requirements.title: Talent Acquisition
requirements.transferRequirements: ​One course, equivalent to 3 units, in workforce planning or a valid GPHR certification from the HR Certification Institute (HRCI).

requirements.title: Applied Probability and Statistics
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in statistics.

requirements.title: Fundamentals of Spreadsheets and Data Presentations
requirements.transferRequirements: ​One course, equivalent to 3 units, in spreadsheets. This course must be taken within the past 5 years. Cannot be satisfied by an associate or bachelor’s degree.

requirements.title: Values-Based Leadership
requirements.transferRequirements: This course can be completed at WGU prior to enrolling in a degree program.

requirements.title: Strategic Training and Development
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in organizational training and development.

requirements.title: Design Thinking for Business
requirements.transferRequirements: ​One course, equivalent to 3 units, in design thinking.

requirements.title: Quantitative Analysis For Business
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in statistics and business decision-making. Can be satisfied by an associate or bachelor’s degree in business excluding AAS degrees.

requirements.title: Principles of Economics
requirements.transferRequirements: ​One course, equivalent to 3 units, in economics.

requirements.title: World History: Diverse Cultures and Global Connections
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in U.S. history, world history, political science, government, economics, or geography (excluding physical geography).

requirements.title: Business Environment Applications II: Process, Logistics, and Operations
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 2 units, in business operations as it applies to process and logistics.

requirements.title: Integrated Physical Sciences
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in physical or life science (chemistry, geology, physics, astronomy, or biology).

requirements.title: Managing in a Global Business Environment
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in global or international business. Cannot be satisfied by an associate or bachelor’s degree.

requirements.title: Project Management
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in project management or one of the following certifications: CompTIA Project+, or the PMI: PMP or CAPM. Course/certification must be completed within 5 years of the student's start date.

requirements.title: Ethics in Technology
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in ethical issues regarding technology.

requirements.title: Organizational Behavior
requirements.transferRequirements: One course, equivalent to 3 units, in organizational behavior.
